schema.title: Action Request
schema.description: Standardized HTTP trigger schema for the fetchEmails flow.

action.description: The operation to perform. Can be null.

operation.description: The specific operation name. Can be null.

source.description: Source system initiating the request. Can be null.

userEmail.description: The initiating user's email address. Can be null.

method.description: Request or execution method. Can be null.

id.description: Primary identifier associated with the request. Can be null.

device.description: Device information related to the request. Can be null.

folderPath.description: Mailbox folder path to fetch emails from. Can be null.

top.description: Maximum number of emails to return. Can be null.

skip.description: Number of emails to skip for paging. Can be null.

fetchOnlyUnread.description: Whether to fetch only unread emails. Can be null.

value.message: Emails retrieval scope failed or timed out.
